items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: She'd say, "I may not play it."

ctx.x: You know, you were saying about Lillby (PHONETIC) and the jealous woman, how did you know that?

(Unintelligible) I might not play it, but I know she was talking to me, you know. But she'd say to me to Louis, so Louis (inaudible). So Louis (inaudible). She'd say, "I may not play it." I said, "Well, you don't have
to play it, baby, because I can play it myself." And that's where I got to play on record.
